tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page. The writing surface and the app ground. It stays almost empty.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on the page: inline diagrams, tables, prototypes, the context tray.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, table lines and dividers. Use borders, not shadows. Decorative only, never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Settled text: anything Phlo has organized onto the page. Headings, body and the wordmark's counter-ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, mono labels, running headers, timestamps. 4.5:1 or better on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-wet
tokens.usage: Speech that has not settled yet: live words on their way into the document. Intentionally below 4.5:1 because it is transient and turns into ink within a second. Never use it for text that stays.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: The voice. The live mic dot, the wordmark's lead stripe, the recording state. One vermilion thing on screen at a time. For marks and large type only, never small text.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Theme color 1 and the wordmark's second stripe. Earned: shows up only once ideas cluster. Also links and focus rings.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Theme color 2. Marks, tab flags and chart series. Not for text on paper.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Theme color 3. Marks, tab flags and chart series. Ink text sits on it, never white.

tokens.name: tab
tokens.usage: The sticky-tab color: Phlo touched this. Callouts the AI pulled out, agent results, flagged ideas. Ink text on it.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Covers and empty states. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Document title. Regular weight, never bold: size carries it.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings Phlo creates as it organizes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: People want their memories somewhere they can hold.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase running headers, section numbers, states. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, transcript time codes, source counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, type nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tabs and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between list items and blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its first block.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections. The default breath.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side margins at desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above the title and around covers. Ma: the empty space carries weight.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sticky tabs and table cells. Paper-cut corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Raised blocks: diagrams, prototypes, the context tray.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The voice dot, pills, theme marks.
